steps.title: Admitted lines
steps.body: The retained phrase новый карандаш is masculine singular nominative; новая машина is feminine singular nominative. The adjective agrees with the noun in the phrase, so the car check requires the supplied feminine form но́вая rather than masculine но́вый or plural но́вые. The guided contrast changes the supplied feminine singular nominative phrase но́вая книга to the accusative object phrase но́вую книгу. Both words change in these supplied case pairs. но́вого друга is a masculine animate object phrase and но́вые книги is plural; neither is the requested feminine singular book phrase.

steps.title: Admitted instruction
steps.body: The dictionary form of this adjective is masculine singular nominative но́вый. A phrase can need another gender, number or case even though its dictionary entry uses that form. In the supplied window contrast, но́вое окно is neuter singular nominative and но́вого окна is the genitive phrase. Both adjective and noun change case while remaining neuter singular. Given the request for the genitive continuation of this window phrase, choose но́вого окна rather than the feminine object phrase но́вую книгу or masculine nominative но́вый дом. This is recognition of the shown pair, not a generator for unfamiliar nouns or adjectives.

steps.title: Admitted lines

Compare the adjective with the masculine pencil and feminine car examples above: the noun controls the agreement required in that phrase. The supplied синий стол uses the masculine nominative form of a different adjective meaning dark blue. Learn each recorded adjective family; similar meanings or dictionary endings alone do not license every inflection.

steps.title: One adjective, several forms
steps.body: An adjective agrees with its noun in gender, number and case. In хорошее письмо, the adjective describes a neuter singular noun. хоро́ший is the dictionary form: masculine singular nominative. The following forms belong to the same adjective meaning good.

steps.title: Two spelling conditions
steps.body: After ж, ц, ч, ш, or щ, an unstressed о in an ending is written е. That replacement is not a rule for every unstressed о. In хоро́шее, the unstressed ending after ш uses е. The и in хоро́шие follows a different spelling condition: write и rather than ы after ш. Spelling limits the letters in an ending; gender, number and case determine which form is needed.

steps.title: Gender and a worked case change
steps.body: хоро́шая is feminine singular nominative; хоро́шее is neuter singular nominative. In хоро́шая книга, both words are feminine singular nominative. To put the phrase in the accusative singular, change both words: хоро́шая книга becomes хоро́шую книгу. Keep the same noun and feminine singular agreement. хоро́шего друга is masculine animate; хоро́шие книги is plural.

steps.title: Singular, plural and dictionary form
steps.body: хоро́шие is plural nominative. To change хоро́шее from neuter singular nominative to plural nominative, choose хоро́шие. To go back to neuter singular, choose хоро́шее. To supply the dictionary form, choose хоро́ший. These choices test the requested form of the adjective; all the options are already correctly spelled.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the requested adjective form. Use its gender, number and case, then read the explanation.

steps.title: Review forms and spelling
steps.body:
An adjective agrees with its noun in gender, number and case. In хорошее письмо, the adjective describes a neuter singular noun. хоро́ший is the dictionary form: masculine singular nominative. The following forms belong to the same adjective meaning good.

After ж, ц, ч, ш, or щ, an unstressed о in an ending is written е. That replacement is not a rule for every unstressed о. In хоро́шее, the unstressed ending after ш uses е. The и in хоро́шие follows a different spelling condition: write и rather than ы after ш. Spelling limits the letters in an ending; gender, number and case determine which form is needed.

хоро́шая is feminine singular nominative; хоро́шее is neuter singular nominative. In хоро́шая книга, both words are feminine singular nominative. To put the phrase in the accusative singular, change both words: хоро́шая книга becomes хоро́шую книгу. Keep the same noun and feminine singular agreement. хоро́шего друга is masculine animate; хоро́шие книги is plural.

хоро́шие is plural nominative. To change хоро́шее from neuter singular nominative to plural nominative, choose хоро́шие. To go back to neuter singular, choose хоро́шее. To supply the dictionary form, choose хоро́ший. These choices test the requested form of the adjective; all the options are already correctly spelled.

sourceCapabilities.sourceRecordId: adverb-formation:most adverbs are formed by removing the adjectival suffixes "-ий" "-а" or "-е" f
sourceCapabilities.exactSpan: most adverbs are formed by removing the adjectival suffixes "-ий" "-а" or "-е" from an adjective, and replacing them with the adverbial "-о". For example, in Ukrainian, "швидкий", "гарна", and "смачне" (fast, nice, tasty) become "швидко", "гарно", and "смачно" (quickly, nicely, tastily), while in Russian, "быстрый", "хороший" and "прекрасный" (quick, good, wonderful) become "быстро", "хорошо", "прекрасно" (quickly, well, wonderfully).
